_readme: 僅供預覽圖表用的範例資料，日期與規模數字為示意，不代表真實時程。正式資料以根目錄 projects.json 為準。

summary.en: Enterprise carbon-emissions management system: multi-language carbon accounting reports, GHG Protocol compliance, emission-factor management, and CBAM-related features
summary.zh: 企業碳排放管理系統：多語系碳盤查報告、GHG Protocol 合規、排放係數管理、CBAM 相關功能

highlight.en: 7-language SQL views, NPOI Excel export with embedded images, and GHG data aggregation logic
highlight.zh: 7 語系 SQL Views、NPOI Excel 匯出含圖片、GHG 資料彙整邏輯

scaleNote.en: Sample: multiple enterprise clients onboarded, 7-language UI
scaleNote.zh: 示意：多家企業客戶導入，7 語系介面

title.zh: 即時語音翻譯系統（碩士論文）

summary.en: A real-time system pairing speech-to-text with LLM-based translation; built a manually-corrected ground-truth dataset to benchmark the system's output accuracy
summary.zh: Speech-to-text 銜接 LLM 翻譯的即時系統；建立人工校正的 ground truth 資料集並比對系統輸出準確度

highlight.en: Tackling recognition and translation accuracy when speakers code-switch between languages mid-session
highlight.zh: 處理多語言 code-switching 場景下的辨識與翻譯準確度問題

summary.en: Tool-retrieval architecture for a large API system: a normalized SQL API-catalog schema plus LLM (Gemini)-based routing design
summary.zh: 大型 API 系統的 Tool Retrieval 架構：正規化 SQL API catalog schema + LLM (Gemini) 選路設計

highlight.en: Compiled API-documentation best practices, distinguishing which recommendations are research-backed versus self-synthesized
highlight.zh: API 文件格式最佳實務整理，並區分哪些建議有研究依據、哪些是自行歸納

scaleNote.zh: 示意：涵蓋約 300+ API 端點

summary.en: Vocabulary practice app (web + Android): daily review cards, a review queue, and a Goals page — built to prepare for the TOEIC exam
summary.zh: 單字練習 App（Web + Android）：Daily 卡片、複習、Goals 目標排程，用來準備多益

highlight.en: The Goals page auto-calculates daily practice load from a target scope and deadline
highlight.zh: Goals 頁面可依目標範圍與期限自動換算每日練習量

summary.en: 3D modeling and generative-AI development for an original character, Babu — an ice-cream creature — aimed at LINE stickers or social media exposure
summary.zh: 原創角色叭噗（冰淇淋生物）的 3D 建模與生成式 AI 開發，目標是做成 LINE 貼圖／社群曝光

highlight.en: Three.js rebuild: lathe geometry + toon shading + inverted-hull outlines
highlight.zh: Three.js 重建：lathe geometry + toon shading + inverted hull outline
